subject: Request: trial reprieve & credit top-up due to CheckoutX integration delay
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@checkoutx.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, support@checkoutx.com
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Build delay — asking for trial reprieve and a short credits top-up

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week. We're excited about Redwood but we've hit a blocker on our Checkout integration: our tokenization step is failing intermittently when the cart payload includes multiple shipping options. The engineering lead has pulled a stacktrace and we attached a small snippet (integration-error.log) and a screenshot of the stacktrace (checkoutx-stacktrace.png).

Because of this, our dev squad has to pause the Redwood PoC until Friday of next week. That pushes our demo date and risks us running out of the trial credits before we even get to the performance benchmarks that matter.

Can Redwood extend the trial window by two weeks and top up the sandbox credits so we can finish the integration and run the demo? Our procurement is on standby and we expect to convert if the demo goes well — deal id: DX-4712 in HubSpot.

Attached: integration-error.log (text), checkoutx-stacktrace.png (image)

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Head of Integrations, CheckoutX
emily@checkoutx.com

On Wed, Mar 12, 2025 at 09:12 AM support@checkoutx.com wrote:
> Re: Log dump attached for your reference.
> --
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@checkoutx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Build delay — asking for trial reprieve and a short credits top-up

Hi Emily — sorry to hear you're blocked. Appreciate the logs, that helps.

Quick questions so I can escalate this internally with the right ask:
- Can you confirm the latest commit SHA or the integration branch name where the failure reproduces?
- Are you seeing this on both the test and staging connectors or only staging?
- Do you have an ETA for when your eng team expects a fix (best / worst case)?

I'll loop in Mark (our eng manager) and Ben on the commercial side. If we escalate today we can often approve a short extension and a modest sandbox credit top-up for partner PoCs — contingent on a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can track progress to demo.

If you can, reply with the branch/commit and a brief timeline; I'll aim to get a decision by EOD.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: integration-error.log
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily@checkoutx.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Mar 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Build delay — asking for trial reprieve and a short credits top-up

Thanks for the context — reviewed the logs quickly. Looks like a payload validation edge-case that should be straightforward to reproduce.

From an engineering and commercial standpoint I'm comfortable approving the following to keep momentum:
- 14-day trial extension starting from 2025-03-14 (we'll set last_day = 2025-03-28)
- 10,000 free inference tokens credited to the project's sandbox pool for CheckoutX PoC

Conditions:
1) Emily provides the commit/branch + steps to reproduce by EOD 2025-03-14.
2) We agree a short MAP with two checkpoints (fix verification and demo readiness) by 2025-03-17.
3) If the PoC converts to committed Dedicated or Hosted usage within 60 days, the top-up is considered promotional credit; otherwise unused sandbox tokens will expire.

I've opened internal ticket RFC-9987 to record the credit allocation and billing hold. Ben, please confirm the credit entry and update HubSpot (DX-4712). Grace, can you send Emily the MAP template?

— Mark (Markus) Klein
Engineering Manager, Redwoods Serving Runtime
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: none
From: Emily Zhang <emily@checkoutx.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, support@checkoutx.com
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Build delay — asking for trial reprieve and a short credits top-up

Hi Grace / Mark / Ben — this is great, thank you. We can meet the conditions.

Commit/branch: feature/checkoutx-shipping-fix (SHA ab12f3e)
Repro steps (high level):
1) Create cart with 2 items + multiple shipping options
2) Trigger tokenization with partner gateway in sandbox mode
3) Observe intermittent 500 from our adapter after the second shipping option is added

ETA for fix: our eng lead expects a patch by 2025-03-16, test and verify by 2025-03-17.

Attached is the full log extract and a short video capture; we'll drop the video into the shared Drive link below. We accept the MAP conditions and appreciate the credits & extension — this will keep our demo on track.

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-link
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4712

Thanks — Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Integrations, CheckoutX
emily@checkoutx.com

Attachments: integration-error.log (full), checkoutx-stacktrace.png
